name: Strato Apartment

facts_sl.bedrooms: 2 spalnici (velika zakonska postelja in zakonska postelja) ter raztegljiv kavč
facts_sl.lake: Kočevsko jezero je približno 270 m od apartmaja
facts_sl.checkin: Prijava od 15:00 (osebni sprejem ali samostojna prijava s kodo)
facts_sl.rules: Kajenje samo na terasi in zunaj; nočni mir 22:00–07:00; hišni ljubljenčki niso dovoljeni
facts_sl.parking: Zasebno parkirišče in dvorišče na posesti
facts_sl.kitchen: Popolnoma opremljena kuhinja: kavni aparati, kuhalnik vode, blender, pomivalni stroj, indukcijska plošča, pečica, hladilnik, mikrovalovna pečica, osnovna živila
facts_sl.bedroom1: Velika spalnica z multimedijo, knjigami in ambientno osvetlitvijo
facts_sl.bedroom2: Manjša spalnica s TV in igralno konzolo Xbox ter dvema sedalnima vrečama
facts_sl.living: Dnevna soba s TV, klavirjem, kitaro in tolkali, otroškimi igračami in družabnimi igrami; neposreden izhod na teraso
facts_sl.bathroom: Kopalnica s tušem, pralni stroj, sušilec za lase, kozmetično ogledalo
facts_sl.climate: Ogrevanje s toplotno črpalko, klimatska naprava
facts_sl.outdoor: Terasa s senčnikom, vrt, prostor za žar
facts_sl.extras: Brezplačen WiFi, otroška posteljica, zasebni vhod, copati, dežniki, knjiga gostov

facts_en.bedrooms: 2 bedrooms (a king-size and a double bed) plus a sofa bed
facts_en.lake: Lake Kočevje is about 270 m from the apartment
facts_en.center: about 400 m to Kočevje town centre
facts_en.checkin: Check-in from 15:00 (in person or self check-in with a code)
facts_en.rules: Smoking only on the terrace and outside; quiet hours 22:00–07:00; pets are not allowed
facts_en.parking: Private parking and courtyard on the property
facts_en.kitchen: Fully equipped kitchen: coffee machines, kettle, blender, dishwasher, induction hob, oven, fridge, microwave, basic supplies
facts_en.bedroom1: Large bedroom with media, books and ambient lighting
facts_en.bedroom2: Smaller bedroom with a TV, an Xbox console and two bean bags
facts_en.living: Living room with TV, piano, guitar and percussion, children's toys and board games; direct access to the terrace
facts_en.bathroom: Bathroom with shower, washing machine, hair dryer, cosmetic mirror
facts_en.outdoor: Terrace with sunshade, garden, barbecue area
facts_en.extras: Free WiFi, baby cot, private entrance, slippers, umbrellas, guest book
